description:
Wao is a voice keyboard that understands Thai the way people actually speak it: Thai with English words mixed in. Say "บ่ายนี้ต้อง deploy ก่อน meeting" and the English words come out in English. No switching languages, no fixing it afterwards.

Everything stays on your iPhone
Your voice never leaves the device. Wao transcribes with an open-source Thai speech model that runs on the phone itself. No servers, no accounts, no ads, no data collection, and it works without an internet connection.

Works in every app
LINE, Notes, Mail, Messages or any app you can type in. Switch to the Wao keyboard, tap the mic, watch your words appear as you speak, and tap to confirm.

Your own vocabulary
Add names, companies, products and work terms you use often so they are spelled right. Organise them in groups you can switch on and off, and paste many at once separated by commas.

A real keyboard too
Without Full Access, Wao still works as a regular Thai and English typing keyboard.

Getting started
1. Open the app and download the speech model once (about 1 GB, Wi-Fi recommended). You can leave the app while it downloads, and pause and resume.
2. Allow the microphone.
3. Add the Wao keyboard in Settings and turn on Full Access to dictate.

Why Full Access?
iOS doesn't let keyboards use the microphone. The Wao app listens and transcribes, then hands the text to the keyboard through a shared container on the device, which iOS only allows with Full Access. Nothing leaves your phone.

Speech recognition by OpenThai2.0-ASR from iApp Technology and AIEAT, released as open source.
promotionalText: Speak Thai with English mixed in and type in any app. Transcribed on your iPhone; your voice never leaves the device.
